I'm excited to share that the Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) area in Vanderbilt University's new College of Connected Computing is hiring faculty at the Assistant and Associate Professor levels!

We are building a vibrant, interdisciplinary HCI community and are looking for colleagues whose research advances our understanding of how people interact with technology and how we can design, develop, and evaluate usable, accessible, and socially responsible technologies.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape a growing HCI area, collaborate across disciplines, and contribute to the future of computing at Vanderbilt.

Open positions:

•

Assistant Professor:

I would be grateful if you could share these opportunities with your colleagues, students, and broader professional networks. Please also feel free to reach out if you have questions or would like to learn more about our growing HCI community.
